messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content: 邁克贏了。邁克的牌是 9♠ 10♠ J♠ Q♠ K♠，形成了順子加花色（straight‑flush），而約翰的牌雖然都是紅心（flush），但沒有順子，且最高牌也比邁克低。因為順子加花色比單純的花色更高，邁克勝出。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has a straight flush? Let's see: 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. Wait missing 9♥. So it's not a straight flush. It's a flush (all hearts). But missing 9. So it's a flush with high cards: K, Q, J, 10, 8. Mike has 9♠, J♠, 10♠, Q♠, K♠. That's also a flush (spades). But missing 8. So Mike's flush has K, Q, J, 10, 9. So Mike's flush is higher because his lowest card is 9 vs John's 8. So Mike wins. But check if any straight? John's cards: 8,10,J,Q,K. Not consecutive. Mike: 9,10,J,Q,K. That's a straight? 9,10,J,Q,K is a straight. But it's also a flush. So Mike has a straight flush? Wait 9♠,10♠,J♠,Q♠,K♠ is indeed a straight flush (9-10-J-Q-K). So Mike has a straight flush. John has a flush. Straight flush beats flush. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
